metas.name: 2026 · Masterplan
metas.description: A master thief enlists two strangers for a Louvre heist targeting the Mona Lisa, then reveals they're his children and siblings who must cooperate to pull off history's greatest art theft.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Street Fighter
metas.description: Street Fighters Ryu and Ken reunite when Chun-Li recruits them for the World Warrior Tournament. As they face a hidden conspiracy, they must confront each other and their past-or face destruction.

metas.name: 2026 · Animals
metas.description: Desperate to pay their son's ransom, a mayoral candidate and his wife resort to extreme measures, revealing dark secrets they never intended to bring to light.

metas.name: 2026 · Matchbox
metas.description: Based on the iconic toy automobiles created in 1953.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
metas.description: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · Primetime
metas.description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Heart of the Beast
metas.description: After a harrowing plane crash, a Special Forces officer and his combat dog find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

metas.name: 2026 · Resident Evil
metas.description: Follows a hapless courier tasked with delivering a package to a remote hospital. He soon finds himself caught in the middle of an outbreak and must fight through hordes of mutated creatures to survive.

metas.name: 2020 · The Weight
metas.description: Desperate to save what is left of his family, during the height of the Great Depression a battle-scarred veteran is hired to help smuggle a fortune in gold across 100 miles of impenetrable wilderness.

metas.name: 2026 · Run Hide Fight: Infidels
metas.description: When radical Islamic terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

metas.name: 2026 · The Uprising
metas.description: Based on the true story of the uprising that inspired the legend of Robin Hood, Andrew Garfield stars as the leader of a rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II in a fight for justice.

metas.name: 2026 · Hotel Tehran
metas.description: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war torn ex-CIA operators set out to Tehran to take down a life changing score.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Forgotten Island
metas.description: Two best friends become stranded on the mystical world of Nakali, where their only escape might cost them their shared lifetime of memories.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · Runner
metas.description: A former soldier and his unlikely partner become the targets of a ruthless cartel while racing to complete a critical medical delivery and save the life of a little girl.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Mayday
metas.description: Lieutenant Troy Brennan's reconnaissance mission over Soviet territory goes awry, forcing him to crash-land and survive in Russian wilderness while evading capture or rescue.

metas.name: ★ 4.1 · 2026 · The Runner
metas.description: A high-powered attorney must race through London to save her abducted son while following cryptic commands from a mysterious caller.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Onslaught
metas.description: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

metas.name: 2026 · By Any Means
metas.description: A notorious mafia hitman and a young Black FBI agent team up to investigate the murders of civil rights leaders in 1966 Mississippi.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look
metas.description: See an extended look at "Grand Theft Auto VI", the next evolution in the groundbreaking "Grand Theft Auto" series.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · The Dog Stars
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus wipes out humanity. Survivors face roaming scavengers called Reapers. Protagonist Hig, a pilot, survived the flu but lost his wife.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Facing El Chapo
metas.description: Follows two cops who in a routine stop pull over a stolen car only to come face to face with one of the most dangerous criminals in the world.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2026 · Mutiny
metas.description: After his billionaire industrialist boss is murdered in front of him, Cole Reed is set up to take the fall for the crime -- leaving him on the run as he works to uncover an international conspiracy.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · The End of Oak Street
metas.description: The Platt family bands together to navigate their new surroundings after a cosmic event transports their suburban neighborhood to someplace unknown.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2026 · The Last House
metas.description: A family of four is suddenly sealed inside their house with no way out and must work together to survive against both their dwindling resources and the mysterious, looming threat that is keeping them trapped.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2026 · Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: 2026 · Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
metas.description: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2026 · Motor City
metas.description: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl. In retaliation, the gangster enacts a frame job to send the innocent man to prison. Life ruined, Miller plots a revenge campaign against the man who took his girl away.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2026 · PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
metas.description: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

metas.name: ★ 5.1 · 2026 · Ip Man: Kung Fu Legend
metas.description: In 1950s Hong Kong, British merchants and Chinese triads have joined forces to expand their territory, forcibly demolishing factories without regard for public welfare. This move draws fierce opposition from Ip Man, standing up for the workers, he faces pressure from all sides. Framed for murder, he is sent to prison. Within the prison walls, the triads set multiple deadly traps. Can Ip Man overcome these trials, escape the danger, and clear his name?
